summary: Rigel Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K to report completion of an exclusive license agreement with Arvinas, Inc., Arvinas Operations, Inc., Arvinas Estrogen Receptor, Inc. and Pfizer Inc. as licensors. Under the deal, Rigel obtained exclusive global rights to develop, manufacture and commercialize VEPPANU (vepdegestrant) and related products. Rigel paid a one-time upfront payment of $70.0 million. The closing followed early termination of the HSR waiting period and satisfaction of other conditions. This is an asset acquisition via exclusive license. Watch for milestone or royalty terms, regulatory progress, and potential competitive dynamics in the targeted therapeutic area.
